## What we adopt
Settings page layout: left settings nav, right card with read-only fields and actions.

## What Ad Astra changes
Fields: this PC's address, lab connection code (regenerate), port, firewall status, connected lab PCs count.

Ad Astra branding (plan §1.1) always overrides template colours and logos.
